scope: Surge and Manifest local Account Profile, Preferences and Security with real menu navigation, theme/default-view integration and opt-in native tooltip/motion preferences.
actualFreeReUIReuse: Existing project AtlasAccountSettings reuses official free ReUI Frame plus existing shadcn/Radix Field, Tabs, Select, Switch and project SettingsRow/SettingsChoice instead of rebuilding Commerce account fields.
Existing DrivePhoneInput and DriveTimezone reuse their actual free PhoneInput/BaseUI Combobox compositions.
Actual free Sidebar/SidebarNavigation and the existing native Radix menus retain selection, keyboard, portal positioning and focus behavior.

Existing LocalAvatarUpload reuses the free c-file-upload-2/useFileUpload implementation and existing outline Button. Its round div/img preview is not a ui/Avatar import. Commerce supplies presentation arguments to this uploader.
correctedDuplication: Commerce shares the existing Atlas account view/model and free settings/upload controls; no parallel hand-built account form or replacement upload engine is added.
customGaps: Merchant-specific local account state, raw-query-preserving hash routing, menu callbacks and default-view handoff are application integration absent from the free controls.
Opt-in React motion context forwards local preference values to existing portalled surfaces; it does not replace their primitives or positioning engines.
Small scoped commerce layout rules supply public-preview spacing, mobile navigation header and avatar/button presentation.
verifiedBehavior: Native Account menu opens Profile, Preferences and Security; Tabs and raw query deep links agree.
Mobile navigation uses its native Sheet, 56px header and 75vw width; choosing Account preserves the open Sheet until native Escape/focus return.

Profile validates name/email. Native phone/country/timezone controls support selection and Save/Cancel; role selector has five actual options; real file chooser/upload/Save/Cancel updates the account image.
Theme changes agree between menu and Preferences. Four saved default-view choices return through the real local Sign Out/Auth/Back/Log in flow.

Tooltip preference disables and restores real native navigation/account/collapse hints. Opt-in reduced motion includes portalled Sheet and BaseUI timezone, with no-provider Atlas compatibility checked on the site.
Commerce avatar stays circular and Remove keeps a real outline and aria-hidden X; upload persistence and Remove/Cancel remain functional.

retainedFailureHistory.motionCause: BaseUI removes a temporary transition shorthand after mount, clearing unchanged React longhands. True-only duration/delay utility classes preserve reduced motion; false behavior and the original computed-duration assertions remain.
retainedFailureHistory.tooltipCause: Global smooth root scrolling after native keyboard focus triggered the native tooltip ancestor-scroll close. Only mounted Surge/Manifest app surfaces restore instant document scrolling; the native tooltip close behavior and original assertions remain.
retainedFailureHistory.visualCause: Atlas-specific square-avatar and muted-action rules leaked into Commerce through its old root class. Commerce now supplies its own root class and existing removeLabel presentation, preserving Atlas default false.
retainedFailureHistory.standaloneRoute: The empty original mount now canonicalizes its owned root to #/ before the unchanged raw query. Site and foreign routes retain their previous behavior.

originalProjectsFirst.fact: Surge17 passed; Manifest16 passed and its restored-false motion comparison failed. Trace proved that the original comparison sampled BaseUI temporary data-starting-style/transition:none, unlike the initial sample after mount cleanup.

mountReadinessCorrection.fact: Only timezonePhase adds real data-open and absence-of-data-starting-style readiness before the original capture. Every original timing/geometry/focus/selection assertion and budget remains; no false-mode product style was added.
